title: Scalar normalization of individual external cup products with unit coefficients
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $X,Y$ be schemes over $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], with bijective structure ring maps $k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $k\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$. Write $f,g$ for the structure morphisms and $P=X\times_kY$, with projections $p_X,p_Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $F=\mathcal O_X$, $G=\mathcal O_Y$ be the unit module sheaves, and $E=p_X^*F\otimes p_Y^*G$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. There exist additive equivalences $e_X:H^1_{\mathrm{mod}}(X,F)\cong H^1(X,\mathcal O_X)$, $e_Y:H^1_{\mathrm{mod}}(Y,G)\cong H^1(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, $e_P:H^1_{\mathrm{mod}}(P,E)\cong H^1(P,\mathcal O_P)$, and $k$-linear equivalences $d_X:H^0_{\mathrm{mod}}(X,F)\cong k$, $d_Y:H^0_{\mathrm{mod}}(Y,G)\cong k$, such that $e_P(p_X^*a\cup p_Y^*b)=p_X^*e_X(d_Y(b)a)$ for all $a\in H^1_{\mathrm{mod}}(X,F)$, $b\in H^0_{\mathrm{mod}}(Y,G)$, and $e_P(p_X^*a\cup p_Y^*b)=p_Y^*e_Y(d_X(a)b)$ for all $a\in H^0_{\mathrm{mod}}(X,F)$, $b\in H^1_{\mathrm{mod}}(Y,G)$. The abelian cohomology and its pullbacks are those of [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. No properness, compactness, separatedness or spanning assertion is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: For the unit modules on X and Y apply the module-to-abelian cohomology comparison, and identify the terminal-open abelian cohomology with Ext from the constant integer sheaf using the constant-sheaf adjunction. This supplies additive equivalences eX,eY. On P use tensor pullback of the unit and the tensor unitor to identify the external coefficient module with O_P; apply its induced cohomology isomorphism followed by the same comparison to obtain eP.

Evaluation at 1 identifies degree-zero unit-module cohomology with global sections k-linearly for the restricted scalar action. Invert each bijective structure ring map k to Gamma(X,O_X) or Gamma(Y,O_Y) and compose with this evaluation to obtain the linear scalar coordinates dX,dY.

Compute the comparisons on injective module resolutions: the underlying abelian global-sections complex computes the same cohomology because forgotten injective modules are acyclic. A resolution map lifting the structure morphism gives the same cohomology pullback on both sides; uniqueness of comparison maps up to homotopy identifies the derived-functor and Ext constructions. For the external cup products use a computing tensor pairing (or the Godement pairing) extending multiplication of sections. Forgetting preserves this pairing. After the unit-coefficient identification the pairing is multiplication; on a degree-zero scalar section r it is the chain map multiplying by r. The pulled-back scalar section remains r since both projections are over k. Thus in degrees (1,0) the image is pX*(eX(dY(b) times a)); in degrees (0,1) it is pY*(eY(dX(a) times b)). There is no sign because one degree is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_external_cup_scalar_comparison (k : Type u) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (hX : Function.Bijective (scalarMap f ⊤))
    (hY : Function.Bijective (scalarMap g ⊤)) :
    let F := SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
    let G := SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf
    ∃ (eX : scalarCohomology f F 1 ≃+ Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb X) 1)
      (eY : scalarCohomology g G 1 ≃+ Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb Y) 1)
      (eP : scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) 1
        ≃+ Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f g)) 1)
      (dX : scalarCohomology f F 0 ≃ₗ[k] k)
      (dY : scalarCohomology g G 0 ≃ₗ[k] k),
      (∀ (a : scalarCohomology f F 1) (b : scalarCohomology g G 0),
        eP (externalCup f g F G 1 0 a b) =
          structureSheafCohomologyPullback (pullback.fst f g) 1 (eX (dY b • a))) ∧
      (∀ (a : scalarCohomology f F 0) (b : scalarCohomology g G 1),
        eP (externalCup f g F G 0 1 a b) =
          structureSheafCohomologyPullback (pullback.snd f g) 1 (eY (dX a • b)))
